health.caveat: LEAKAGE BY CONSTRUCTION. The dataset generator derives both financial_profiles and behavior_labels by aggregating the same transactions these features are built from: label_savings_rate is close to the savings_rate feature, and the behaviour flags are thresholded versions of late_month_share, cash_dependency, expense_income_ratio and emergency_buffer_months. A model can therefore reach a very high R2 / F1 while learning nothing a rule could not, because it is re-deriving a statistic it was handed. Read the null_control and direct_feature_baseline rows beside every score: the honest claim is that the pipeline reproduces the ground truth reliably on unseen customers and unseen months, NOT that it predicts future financial behaviour. Proving the latter needs held-out real-customer data, which does not exist for this challenge.
